ModMetaData.name: Mineuchi (Mercy Strike) - 1.5 Backport
ModMetaData.author: Allen Patch; original design by AzureMine
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5.4063 behavioral backport/reimplementation of AzureMine's Mineuchi (Mercy Strike) concept. Adds a drafted-only Mercy Strike toggle for controlled non-lethal melee combat: skill-scaled accuracy penalty, safer body-part targeting, forced blunt primary damage, human damage cap, body-part preservation and the Suppression system. Built independently from the public mechanics description because the original source was not publicly available during the backport.
